question: Which of blocks 9, 10, and 11 converts the confirmed L8H1 write into the sparse occupied M11 reader mode?
evidence_status: Prospective. L9H1/H4 boundary outcomes are open, but no v23 L8H1 boundary state or transport score has been opened.

frozen_design.measurement: Use the same identity-carry diagnostic as the sealed L9 experiment: add each patched-minus-base residual delta to the base block11 post-attention raw state, then apply exact RMS/M11 and project into the frozen reader basis. The actual post-attention raw and normalized boundaries are closure controls.
frozen_design.controls: Score the frozen 30 target rows, P, C, and two reporter halves separately. No boundary, rank, coordinate, or dose is selected before outcomes.

predictions.pred_a_authority_hooks_boundaries_closur: All hashes, hook counts, closures, self no-op, finiteness, and four-forward price pass.
predictions.pred_b_L8H1_localizes_before_block11_att: At least one of block9, block10, or block11 input passes cosine >=.90 and residual <=.25.
predictions.pred_c_block10_or_earlier_is_sufficient: Block9 or block10 input passes, placing the essential conversion no later than block9.
predictions.pred_d_earliest_boundary_is_split_stable: The earliest passing boundary has >=.90 cosine in both reporter halves and actual P/C projected-response RMS below target RMS.

opposing_interpretations.block8_write_ready: Block9 input passes: L8H1 emits the transferable variable directly.
opposing_interpretations.block9_converter: Block10 input first passes: block9 converts L8H1 into the shared transport interface.
opposing_interpretations.block10_or_11_converter: Only block11 input or post-attention raw passes: later computation is essential and must be grouped with L8H1.
opposing_interpretations.distributed_transport: Only the normalized closure passes: retain a multi-block state-dependent transport rather than a single edge.

null: With valid A, failure of B means no tested pre-normalization boundary is a sufficient L8H1 transport interface; preserve the full multi-block causal route. Failure of C specifically rejects an early block8/9-ready write.
decision: The earliest stable selective boundary completes the writer-side transport specification for the fourth confirmed head, after which the program moves to necessity/removal and M11 rescue.
